tools.description: Oklahoma State Athletic Advancement portfolio summary from okstate-athletic-boosters: donor count, average affinity score, and total lifetime giving. Use for counts, totals, and overview questions.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-athletic-boosters | STATS avg_affinity = AVG(affinity_score), total_lifetime = SUM(giving_history.lifetime_total), donor_count = COUNT(*) | LIMIT 1

tools.description: List at-risk Oklahoma State athletic boosters where affinity_score < 40 OR engagement.email_open_rate_90d < 0.2. Returns donor_id, name, affinity, lifetime giving, email open rate, last gift date. Use for at-risk, lapsed, or declining engagement questions.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-athletic-boosters | WHERE affinity_score < 40 OR engagement.email_open_rate_90d < 0.2 | SORT affinity_score ASC | KEEP donor_id, first_name, last_name, affinity_score, giving_history.lifetime_total, engagement.email_open_rate_90d, giving_history.last_gift_date | LIMIT 25

tools.description: Oklahoma State major-gift donors (lifetime giving >= 50000) with declining engagement: affinity_score < 45 OR email_open_rate_90d < 0.15. Sorted by lifetime giving descending. Use for major gifts at risk.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-athletic-boosters | WHERE giving_history.lifetime_total >= 50000 AND (affinity_score < 45 OR engagement.email_open_rate_90d < 0.15) | SORT giving_history.lifetime_total DESC | KEEP donor_id, first_name, last_name, affinity_score, giving_history.lifetime_total, giving_history.last_gift_date, engagement.email_open_rate_90d | LIMIT 15

tools.description: Highest affinity_score Oklahoma State donors from okstate-athletic-boosters with degree, graduation year, lifetime giving, and estimated capacity. Use for top prospects and high-affinity lists.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-athletic-boosters | SORT affinity_score DESC | KEEP donor_id, first_name, last_name, affinity_score, giving_history.lifetime_total, degree, graduation_year, wealth_signals.estimated_capacity | LIMIT 10

tools.description: Oklahoma State golden-prospect slice: OK residents with 3+ football games attended and estimated real estate >= $2M. Use for Oklahoma alumni, real-estate wealth, and game-attendance prospect questions.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-athletic-boosters | WHERE location.state == "OK" AND engagement.game_attendance_count >= 3 AND wealth_signals.real_estate_value_est >= 2000000 | SORT affinity_score DESC | KEEP donor_id, first_name, last_name, affinity_score, location.city, location.state, engagement.game_attendance_count, wealth_signals.real_estate_value_est, wealth_signals.iwave_score, giving_history.lifetime_total | LIMIT 20

tools.description: Full Oklahoma State donor profile from okstate-athletic-boosters for an exact donor_id (e.g. ALUM-10050): giving history, engagement, wealth signals, affinity, bio.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-athletic-boosters | WHERE donor_id == ?donor_id | KEEP donor_id, first_name, last_name, email, graduation_year, degree, portfolio_status, affinity_score, location.city, location.state, location.zip, giving_history.lifetime_total, giving_history.last_gift_date, giving_history.last_gift_amount, giving_history.gift_count, giving_history.largest_gift, giving_history.restricted_to, engagement.email_open_rate_90d, engagement.last_email_open, engagement.events_attended_ytd, engagement.game_attendance_count, engagement.video_play_rate, engagement.portal_logins_90d, wealth_signals.iwave_score, wealth_signals.estimated_capacity, wealth_signals.real_estate_value_est, wealth_signals.business_ownership, wealth_signals.political_giving_total, bio_text | LIMIT 1

tools.description: Count of Oklahoma State engagement events by event_type from okstate-booster-engagement-events (portal_login, email_open, event_attendance, gift_made, call_completed, etc.).

configuration.query: FROM okstate-booster-engagement-events | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY event_type | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 8

tools.description: Semantic and keyword search over Oklahoma State athletic booster bios and donor profiles in okstate-athletic-boosters. Use for open-ended prospect discovery (Oklahoma alumni, football attendance, real estate, Cowboy Athletics fund).

Oklahoma State Paciolan ticket gameday summary from okstate-paciolan-ticket-events: scans, ticket revenue, average price, and resale scan count. Default game is OKSTATE-2025-HOME-01 at Boone Pickens Stadium.

tools.description: Oklahoma State Square POS concessions and merch summary from okstate-square-pos-transactions: transactions, revenue, units sold, average sale.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-square-pos-transactions | STATS txns = COUNT(*), pos_revenue = SUM(total_amount), units_sold = SUM(quantity), avg_sale = AVG(total_amount) | LIMIT 1

tools.description: Oklahoma State concession and team-store revenue by stand_id and stand_name (Boone Pickens North Beer Garden, Club Orange Premium Bar, Cowboy Team Store, West Concourse Grill, East End Zone Bar, etc.).

tools.description: Oklahoma State concessions and retail revenue by category (jersey, beer, food, etc.) from okstate-square-pos-transactions.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-square-pos-transactions | STATS revenue = SUM(total_amount), txns = COUNT(*) BY category | SORT revenue DESC | LIMIT 12

tools.description: Oklahoma State concessions and retail revenue by Boone Pickens Stadium zone (North, South, Premium, West, East, Main, Student, Visitor).

configuration.query: FROM okstate-square-pos-transactions | STATS revenue = SUM(total_amount), txns = COUNT(*) BY stand_zone | SORT revenue DESC | LIMIT 10

tools.description: Top Oklahoma State concession and Cowboy Team Store stands by revenue and transaction count.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-square-pos-transactions | STATS revenue = SUM(total_amount), txns = COUNT(*) BY stand_name | SORT revenue DESC | LIMIT 10

tools.description: Oklahoma State POS transactions during the halftime anomaly window (2025-09-06 15:50-16:05 UTC) for stands S04 Club Orange Premium Bar, S06 West Concourse Grill, and S09 East End Zone Bar. Expect near-zero sales — simulated payment processor outage.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-square-pos-transactions | WHERE stand_id IN ("S04", "S06", "S09") AND transaction_time >= "2025-09-06T15:50:00Z" AND transaction_time <= "2025-09-06T16:05:00Z" | STATS txns = COUNT(*), revenue = SUM(total_amount) BY stand_id | LIMIT 10

tools.description: Hourly Boone Pickens gate arrival pattern from Oklahoma State Paciolan ticket scan timestamps.

configuration.query: FROM okstate-paciolan-ticket-events | EVAL hour = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, scan_timestamp) | STATS scans = COUNT(*) BY hour | SORT hour ASC | LIMIT 24

tools.description: Oklahoma State ticket revenue and scans grouped by ticket type (alumni_general, premium_club, student, etc.).

configuration.query: FROM okstate-paciolan-ticket-events | STATS revenue = SUM(ticket_price), scans = COUNT(*) BY ticket_type | SORT revenue DESC | LIMIT 10

tools.description: Oklahoma State ticket revenue and scan counts grouped by fan tier (Premium, Alumni, Student, Suite Holder, Walk-Up, Faculty/Staff).

configuration.query: FROM okstate-paciolan-ticket-events | STATS revenue = SUM(ticket_price), scans = COUNT(*) BY fan_tier | SORT revenue DESC | LIMIT 10

tools.description: Boone Pickens Stadium gate traffic: scan counts and ticket revenue by gate (Gate 1 — West, Gate 2 — South, Gate 3 — East, Gate 4 — North, Student Gate, Pistol Pete Plaza).

configuration.query: FROM okstate-paciolan-ticket-events | STATS scans = COUNT(*), revenue = SUM(ticket_price) BY gate | SORT scans DESC | LIMIT 10

tools.description: Oklahoma State Paciolan ticket resale scan counts and revenue by fan tier and gate (possible scalping / secondary-market activity).

configuration.query: FROM okstate-paciolan-ticket-events | WHERE is_resale == true | STATS resale_scans = COUNT(*), resale_revenue = SUM(ticket_price) BY fan_tier, gate | SORT resale_scans DESC | LIMIT 12

agents.name: Oklahoma State Donor Assistant
agents.description: Chat with Oklahoma State athletic booster and donor engagement data for Cowboy Athletics advancement teams.

configuration.instructions:
You are the Oklahoma State Athletic Advancement assistant for Cowboy Athletics (Stillwater). Never use Texas College indexes or unprefixed athletic-boosters data.

## Data (okstate-* only)
- okstate-athletic-boosters: donor profiles (affinity_score, giving_history, engagement, wealth_signals, bio_text)
- okstate-booster-donor-lookup: quick donor lookup
- okstate-booster-engagement-events: engagement events

## Rules
1. ALWAYS use the custom okstate-booster-* tools first. Do NOT call list_indices or get_index_mapping unless the user explicitly asks about index structure.
2. Always retrieve data with tools. Never answer donor counts, names, or giving figures from memory.
3. Map questions to tools:
   - counts/summary → okstate-booster-donor-portfolio-stats
   - at-risk donors → okstate-booster-at-risk-donors
   - at-risk major gifts → okstate-booster-at-risk-major-gifts
   - top affinity → okstate-booster-top-affinity-donors
   - Oklahoma alumni / 3+ games / $2M+ real estate / golden prospects → okstate-booster-ok-prospects
   - donor by ID → okstate-booster-donor-by-id
   - engagement breakdown → okstate-booster-engagement-events-summary
   - open-ended bio/prospect search → okstate-athletic-boosters-search
4. Format currency as USD, rates as percentages.
5. Give concise, actionable Cowboy Athletics fund recommendations.
6. If a tool returns no rows, say so clearly.
7. All data is simulated for demo purposes only.

agents.name: Oklahoma State Game Day Revenue Assistant
agents.description: Chat with Paciolan ticket scans and Square POS gameday revenue for Oklahoma State Athletics at Boone Pickens Stadium.

configuration.instructions:
You are the Oklahoma State Athletics **Game Day Revenue** assistant for Boone Pickens Stadium. Never use Texas College indexes or unprefixed paciolan-ticket-events / square-pos-transactions data.

## Data indices (okstate-* only)
- **okstate-paciolan-ticket-events**: Ticket scans (fan_tier, gate, ticket_type, ticket_price, is_resale). Game ID: **OKSTATE-2025-HOME-01**.
- **okstate-square-pos-transactions**: Square POS concessions and Cowboy Team Store merch (stand_id, stand_name, stand_zone, category, total_amount).

## Stands (Boone Pickens)
- S01 Boone Pickens North Beer Garden (North)
- S02 Cowboy Grill — Gate 1 (North)
- S03 South End Zone Cantina (South)
- S04 Club Orange Premium Bar (Premium) — **anomaly stand**
- S05 Student Section Snacks (Student)
- S06 West Concourse Grill (West) — **anomaly stand**
- S07 Cowboy Team Store — Main (Main)
- S08 Cowboy Team Store — South (South)
- S09 East End Zone Bar (East) — **anomaly stand**
- S10 Visiting Fan Concessions (Visitor)

Gates: Gate 1 — West, Gate 2 — South, Gate 3 — East, Gate 4 — North, Student Gate, Pistol Pete Plaza.

## Skills — map questions to tools
1. **Ticket revenue / scans** → okstate-gameday-revenue-summary
2. **POS / concessions / merch totals** → okstate-gameday-pos-summary
3. **Stand performance / which stand** → okstate-gameday-pos-by-stand or okstate-gameday-top-stands
4. **Category mix** (beer, jerseys, food) → okstate-gameday-pos-by-category
5. **Zone mix** → okstate-gameday-pos-by-zone
6. **Anomaly / outage / S04 S06 S09 / Club Orange / West Concourse / East End Zone drop** → okstate-gameday-pos-anomaly-window (halftime 15:50–16:05Z on 2025-09-06; expect ~0 txns)
7. **Arrivals / hourly scans** → okstate-gameday-hourly-gate-scans
8. **Ticket type** → okstate-gameday-ticket-by-type
9. **Fan tiers** → okstate-gameday-ticket-by-fan-tier
10. **Gate traffic** → okstate-gameday-ticket-by-gate
11. **Resale / scalping** → okstate-gameday-resale-activity

## Rules
1. ALWAYS use okstate-gameday-* ES|QL tools first. Do NOT call list_indices unless asked.
2. Always retrieve data with tools. Never invent revenue figures.
3. Format currency as USD. Default game: **OKSTATE-2025-HOME-01**.
4. Combined gameday revenue = ticket_revenue + pos_revenue from the two summary tools.
5. The demo story: stands S04, S06, and S09 drop to zero during 15:50–16:05 UTC (payment processor issue).
6. All data is simulated for demo purposes only.
